os-28-25.alt: Two Punnett squares, one above the other. Top, labeled generation 1 cross: AA crossed with aa. The AA parent's A alleles run down the side and the aa parent's a alleles across the top; all four boxes read Aa, and an arrow leads to the note that all offspring in generation 2 are Aa, showing the dominant phenotype. Bottom, labeled generation 2 cross: Aa crossed with Aa, with A and a down the side and across the top. The boxes read AA, Aa, Aa and aa, and an arrow leads to the note that in generation 3, 75% are AA or Aa, showing the dominant phenotype, and 25% are aa, showing the recessive phenotype.

os-28-26.alt: A Punnett square for the cross Nn times nn. The Nn parent's alleles, N and n, run down the side and the nn parent's two n alleles across the top. The top two boxes read Nn and the bottom two read nn. An arrow leads to the note that in generation 2, 50% are Nn and have neurofibromatosis, and 50% are nn and do not show the disease.
